items.content_excerpt: OpenAI plans to buy AI chips from Google to expand its computing capacity amid rising demand for AI infrastructure, according to The Information. The deal would deepen commercial ties between the rivals, which compete in AI products and search. Last week, OpenAI said it would make its most advanced models available through Google Cloud.
